messages:
ana: uploaded a perfetto trace for an e2e request (client->gateway->runtime). seeing repeated 8–20ms extra time where gateway.forward_to_runtime seems to overlap runtime.prepare_batch instead of being sequential. trace link: https://perfetto.local/r/abc123 :thinking:

ryan: grabbing it now. do we have nsys output too? overlaps can be scheduling jitter or a KV-cache warmup path

ana: i ran a quick nsys repro: `nsys profile -o e2e_run --trace=cuda,nvtx python -m repro.server --trace-id=run42` — spikes around long seqs (1024) during kernel launch

marie: reminder: canary bumped `batch.max_wait_ms` to 12ms last week — could be related

ana: on dev i flipped batch timeout to 1ms and the overlap mostly disappears, but throughput falls. suspect heuristic holds the gateway slice longer when KV cache misses happen

ryan: perfetto shows slices like:
```
Slice: gateway.forward_to_runtime ts=1623012345 dur=8000
Slice: runtime.prepare_batch   ts=1623012348 dur=15000
Slice: runtime.cuda_kernel      ts=1623012360 dur=18000
```
That sequence implies gateway returns (or at least records end) before the runtime actually queues work; nvtx shows cudaLaunchKernel returns but kernel scheduled later

perfetto-bot: auto-analysis: top hotspots in this trace: aten::matmul (34%), cudaMemcpy (26%), host-side idle (21%)

marie: that host-side idle might be runtime waiting for batch fill or CPU scheduling gaps between gateway and runtime threads. also KV-miss path does extra prefix decode which adds host-side work

ana: another find: kernel-selection code is picking fp32 fallback variant for long sequences in a few runs — that variant does extra workspace alloc and setup, adding jitter

ryan: proposed plan:
- reproduce with `--batch-timeout=1` and `--no-kv-prefetch`
- run nsys with `--trace=cpu,cuda,osrt`
- add NVTX around kernel-selection and KV cache path

ana: i'll kick the repro now and upload artifacts. filing ticket RWI-3129

devops-bot: job run.rwi-3129 started, artifacts will be uploaded to s3://redwood-traces/run-rwi-3129

marie: quick mitigation thought: treat KV cache miss as not triggering the expensive fp32 fallback on first token; prefer warm quantized kernel for lower tail latency

ryan: also add a console histogram for gateway->runtime slice latency (95p alert) so we can detect regressions without digging traces

ana: thanks — will post nsys + trace links when done. :thumbsup:

ryan: i can add a tiny perfetto query to count overlaps if helpful

ana: please do

ryan: query suggestion:
```
SELECT slice.name, COUNT(*) AS overlaps
FROM slice
WHERE slice.name LIKE '%gateway%' OR slice.name LIKE '%runtime%'
GROUP BY slice.name
ORDER BY overlaps DESC
LIMIT 20
```

ana: saved the query. moving changes to branch `rwi/3129-trace-overlap` and will follow up with results
